d: The Thunder defeated the Cavaliers, 117-112 tonight in Cleveland. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander contributed a team-high 43 points to go with 8 assists 4 three pointers and 3 rebounds, with Ajay Mitchell of the Thunder adding an additional 20 points (7-16 FG) and 20 points in the game. Donovan Mitchell finished with a team-high 17 points along with 11 assists for the Cavaliers in the losing effort. The Thunder improve their record to 5-2 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 4-3 for the season.
